Software Engineer Intern, Backend — Fall 2026

The platform team owns the services that every product surface depends on.
As an intern you will ship production code to distributed systems serving
millions of requests per day.

Responsibilities
- Design and build RESTful APIs and backend services
- Write efficient SQL and evolve relational database schemas
- Improve caching and latency of high-throughput endpoints
- Containerize services with Docker and deploy via CI/CD

Requirements
- Pursuing a degree in Computer Science
- Proficiency in Python, Java, or Golang
- Solid understanding of databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and SQL
- Understanding of REST APIs and HTTP
- Experience with Git and testing practices

Nice to have
- Experience with microservices and distributed systems
- Familiarity with NoSQL stores
- Linux fundamentals
